name: Citrus Sunrise Highball
steps: Stir orange and lime juice over ice
Drizzle grenadine down the glass wall so it sinks
Serve unstirred for the sunrise gradient

name: Electric Blue Lagoon Sparkler
steps: Add blue syrup and lemon to an iced glass
Top with lemon-lime soda
Stir once, gently

name: Sparkling Berry Sangria Punch
steps: Drop diced fruit into an iced glass
Pour in grape and orange juice
Top with sparkling cider right before serving

name: Passionfruit Mint Sparkler
steps: Shake passionfruit, lime and agave with ice
Strain over fresh ice
Top with soda; slap a mint sprig to wake the oils

name: Pomegranate Rose Spritz
steps: Combine pomegranate, rose water and lemon
Add ice and top slowly with tonic
Scatter pomegranate seeds

name: Tart Cherry Limeade Fizz
steps: Stir cherry, lime and syrup at the base
Fill with cubed ice
Top with soda

name: Grapefruit Rosemary Spritz
steps: Shake grapefruit, rosemary syrup and lemon with ice
Strain over fresh ice
Top with soda; torch a rosemary sprig

name: Zero-Proof Paloma
steps: Rim the glass with lime and coarse salt
Stir grapefruit, lime and agave
Add ice, top with sparkling water

name: Shirley Temple
steps: Pour lemon juice, grenadine and ginger ale into a chilled glass
Fill the glass with ice
Garnish with a lemon wheel and a maraschino cherry

name: Roy Rogers
steps: Fill a glass with ice and pour in the cola
Add a splash of grenadine and stir gently
Garnish with a maraschino cherry

name: Sparkling Cranberry Mocktail
steps: Pour cranberry and lime over ice
Top with sparkling cider
Garnish with rosemary

name: Sparkling Pomegranate Mocktail
steps: Add pomegranate juice and lemon to a chilled flute
Top with sparkling water

name: Mimosa Mocktail
steps: Pour chilled orange juice into a flute
Top gently with sparkling cider or white grape

name: Rose Mocktail
steps: Add rose syrup to an iced glass
Top with lemon-lime soda and stir

name: Rose & Rhubarb Soda
steps: Stir rhubarb (or strawberry) syrup with rose water and lemon
Add ice and top with soda

name: Beet-Sumac Soda
steps: Stir beet juice, syrup and lemon
Add ice and top with soda water

name: Homemade Tarragon Soda
steps: Steep fresh tarragon (or basil) in warm syrup and cool
Pour over ice with lemon
Top with soda

name: Cider, Thyme & Tonic
steps: Lightly bruise thyme in the glass
Add ice and apple cider
Top with tonic

name: Ranch Water (Zero-Proof)
steps: Add lime and a pinch of salt over ice
Top with very bubbly mineral water

name: Italian Greyhound Spritz
steps: Build grapefruit and orange over ice in a wine glass
Top with tonic for the bitter edge

name: Sparkling Citrus Hibiscus Cooler
steps: Dissolve honey into orange juice at the base with ice
Layer cold hibiscus tea over a spoon
Top with soda for a ruby-to-orange fade

name: Cucumber Mint Hydration Refresher
steps: Muddle cucumber, mint, lime, syrup and salt
Pack with ice
Top with soda

name: Lavender Honey Lemonade
steps: Mix lavender syrup, lemon and honey
Add ice and cold water
Stir well

name: Thyme Blackberry Breeze
steps: Muddle blackberries and thyme
Shake with lemon, syrup and ice
Double strain and top with sparkling cider

name: Basil Watermelon Smash
steps: Muddle watermelon, basil, lime and agave
Fill with crushed ice
Top with ginger ale

name: Elderflower Apple Sparkler
steps: Stir elderflower, apple and lemon with ice
Strain into a chilled glass
Top with sparkling water

name: Chamomile Peach Mule
steps: Fill a mug with ice
Add chamomile, peach and lemon and stir
Top with ginger beer

name: Minted Green Tea Sparkler
steps: Mix green tea, lemongrass syrup and lime over ice
Top with sparkling water

name: Sage Grapefruit Tonic
steps: Bruise sage in the shaker
Shake briefly with grapefruit, honey and ice
Strain over ice and top with tonic

name: Hibiscus Lemongrass Basil Iced Tea
steps: Steep hibiscus with lemongrass and cool
Stir in lime and honey
Pour over ice with torn basil

name: Tangerine Rosemary Mocktail
steps: Shake tangerine juice with rosemary syrup and ice
Strain over ice and top with soda

name: Cranberry Rosemary Refresher
steps: Stir cranberry, rosemary syrup and lime over ice
Top with soda

name: Watermelon Mint Cider-Vinegar Tonic
steps: Blend or muddle watermelon with mint
Shake with vinegar, honey and ice
Strain and top with soda

name: Pineapple Coconut Water
steps: Stir pineapple and fresh ginger juice
Top with coconut water over ice

name: Strawberry Basil Fields
steps: Muddle strawberries and basil
Add lemon, syrup and ice, then stir
Top with soda

name: Classic Lemonade
steps: Stir the lemon juice and simple syrup together
Add cold water and stir well
Pour over ice

name: Pink Strawberry Lemonade
steps: Muddle strawberries with syrup
Add lemon and water over ice

name: Fresh Ginger Lemonade
steps: Grate ginger and steep in warm honey water, then cool
Strain, add lemon and ice

name: Ginger Spiced Lemonade
steps: Simmer ginger with jaggery and a pinch of pepper
Cool, strain, add lemon, water and ice

name: Saffron Cardamom Lemonade
steps: Warm syrup with saffron and crushed cardamom; cool
Stir with lemon, water and ice

name: Arnold Palmer
steps: Stir lemon juice, syrup and cold water into a lemonade
Fill the glass one-third with lemonade and add ice
Top with cold-brewed black tea and stir

name: Lemon Squeeze
steps: Shake lemon and honey with ice
Strain and top with soda

name: Cherry Limeade
steps: Stir the syrup, lime juice and cherry juice together
Pour over a glass of crushed ice
Top with club soda just before serving and stir gently

name: Watermelon Mocktail
steps: Blend watermelon and strain
Stir with lime, mint and salt
Top with soda over ice

name: Virgin Mojito
steps: Lightly press mint with lime and syrup
Pack with crushed ice
Top with soda and lift the mint

name: Cardamom Mojito Mocktail
steps: Crush cardamom pods with mint, lime and syrup
Add crushed ice
Top with soda

name: Pomegranate Mojito Mocktail
steps: Muddle mint with lime and syrup
Add pomegranate juice and ice
Top with soda

name: Virgin Piña Colada
steps: Blend pineapple, coconut cream and lime with a cup of ice
Blend until silky, about 25 seconds

name: Virgin Mary
steps: Stir the tomato juice with lime juice, pepper, chilli and black salt
Pour over ice
Top with a celery stalk

name: Zero-Proof Margarita
steps: Rim the glass with salt using a lime wedge
Shake the lime juice, orange juice and agave with ice for 15 seconds
Strain over fresh ice
Top with sparkling water and garnish with lime

name: Spicy Mango Margarita (Zero-Proof)
steps: Rim with chili salt
Shake mango, lime, agave and a jalapeño slice with ice
Strain over ice and splash soda

name: Zero-Proof Moscow Mule
steps: Muddle the lime quarters in the mug until the juice is released
Clap the mint and press it gently into the lime
Add plenty of ice, top with ginger beer and stir gently
Garnish with mint and a lime wheel

name: Pom Mexican Mule
steps: Build pomegranate and lime over ice
Top with ginger beer

name: Faux Cosmopolitan
steps: Shake the cranberry and lime juice with ice
Strain into a martini glass
Top with sparkling water and a splash of orange juice

name: Virgin Daiquiri (Strawberry)
steps: Blend the strawberries (mostly frozen), lime juice and chilled syrup until smooth
Pour into a tall glass

name: Non-Alcoholic Appletini
steps: Chill a martini glass in the freezer; if you like, rub the rim with lemon and dip it in sugar
Add apple juice, lemon juice and simple syrup to a shaker full of ice and shake hard for 10 to 20 seconds until frosty
Strain into the chilled martini glass (no ice in the glass) and top with the sparkling water, or stir it in gently after straining
Garnish with a slice of green apple and serve right away

name: Watermelon Punch (Zero-Proof)
steps: Blend and strain watermelon
Stir with lime, mint and a whisper of warm spice
Top with soda over ice

name: Pineapple Punch
steps: Stir juices and grenadine over ice
Top with ginger ale

name: 5-Minute Mango Mocktail
steps: Stir mango pulp with lime and mint
Top with lemon-lime soda over ice

name: Penicillin Mocktail
steps: Shake lemon, honey-ginger syrup and smoky lapsang tea with ice
Strain over a big cube

name: Coconut Strawberry Cream Bliss
steps: Purée strawberries into the glass base with crushed ice
Shake coconut milk and vanilla until frothy
Pour gently over the red layer

name: Creamy Banana Chai Frappe
steps: Blend frozen banana, chai and milk until thick
Dust with cinnamon

name: Avocado Lime Frost
steps: Blend avocado, lime, sweetener and coconut water with ice until velvety

name: Frozen Peach Velvet Slush
steps: Blend frozen peaches, grape juice, lemon and honey
Pour the thick slush into a chilled glass

name: Guava Cream Dream
steps: Shake guava, coconut cream, lime and syrup hard with ice
Strain over fresh ice

name: Watermelon Lime Mint Chiller
steps: Blend watermelon, lime, agave and mint with ice until slushy

name: Peanut Butter Banana Coffee Smoothie
steps: Blend frozen banana, chilled coffee, milk, peanut butter and vanilla until smooth

name: Energizing Green Smoothie
steps: Blend greens with banana, pineapple and coconut water until smooth

name: Tropical Fruit Smoothie
steps: Blend all with a handful of ice

name: Blueberry Cashew Buckwheat Smoothie
steps: Blend soaked cashews, blueberries, banana and milk until creamy

name: Berry Banana Protein Shake
steps: Blend everything until smooth and thick

name: Strawberry Milkshake
steps: Blend the strawberries, ice cream and milk until smooth and creamy
Pour into a glass, top with whipped cream and a strawberry

name: Citrus Espresso Tonic
steps: Fill a glass with big ice
Add orange syrup and tonic
Float the cooled espresso slowly on top; express orange peel

name: Iced Vanilla Oat Latte
steps: Stir vanilla into oat milk over ice
Pour espresso slowly for marbling

name: Ginger Cold Brew Fizz
steps: Add ginger beer and lime over ice
Layer cold brew slowly on top

name: Hibiscus Cold Brew Tonic
steps: Combine hibiscus and tonic over ice
Float cold brew on top

name: Salted Caramel Iced Coffee
steps: Stir caramel into cold brew over ice
Top with milk
Finish with flaky salt

name: Spiced Mocha Chiller
steps: Blend coffee, milk, cocoa, maple and a pinch of cayenne with ice
Top with whipped cream and cocoa

name: Cold Brew
steps: Steep coarse grounds in cold water 12-24 h, strain
Dilute over ice

name: Vietnamese Iced Coffee
steps: Brew strong coffee onto condensed milk
Stir and pour over ice

name: Thai Iced Coffee
steps: Mix the two milks and vanilla in the glass
Add ice and pour coffee over

name: Kori-Kohi (Coffee Ice Cubes & Milk)
steps: Freeze sweetened coffee in cube trays
Pour warm or cold milk over the coffee cubes and watch them melt

name: Peanut Butter Iced Coffee
steps: Blend coffee, peanut butter, milk and sweetener
Pour over ice

name: Iced White Chocolate Mocha
steps: Stir white chocolate sauce into cold brew
Add milk and ice

name: Vanilla Sweet Cream Cold Brew
steps: Whisk cream, condensed milk and vanilla
Pour cold brew over ice and float the sweet cream

name: Iced Caramel Macchiato
steps: Vanilla at the bottom, then milk and ice
Pour espresso on top
Lattice caramel over

name: Dirty Horchata
steps: Soak rice, blend with water, strain
Sweeten with honey, cinnamon and vanilla
Add milk, ice and a coffee float

name: Homemade Frappuccino
steps: Blend coffee, milk, sugar and lots of ice
Top with whipped cream

name: Lavender Frappuccino
steps: Blend coffee, milk, lavender syrup and ice

name: Iced Coffee with Ice Cream
steps: Pour chilled coffee and milk over ice
Top with a scoop of ice cream

name: Coconut Milk Iced Coffee
steps: Stir coffee and sweetener over ice
Top with coconut milk

name: Indian Cold Coffee
steps: Add ice cubes, instant coffee, sugar and cold milk to a blender
Blend until frothy and pour into a tall glass; serve right away

name: Iced Pistachio Latte
steps: Blend pistachio with milk and syrup
Pour over ice and float espresso

name: Espresso Martini (Zero-Proof)
steps: Shake hot espresso hard with syrup and ice for a thick crema
Strain into a chilled glass

name: Egg Coffee (Cà Phê Trứng)
steps: Whisk yolks, sugar and condensed milk until pale and thick
Spoon the foam over hot coffee

name: Affogato
steps: Scoop ice cream into a cup
Pour hot espresso over it at the table

name: Mocha Latte
steps: Dissolve coffee and cocoa in hot water
Top with frothed hot milk

name: Dirty Chai Latte
steps: Combine chai and a shot of coffee
Top with frothed milk

name: Mexican Coffee
steps: Brew coffee with cinnamon and a little chocolate
Finish with a splash of milk

name: Café de Olla
steps: Heat water with piloncillo (or jaggery), ground coffee and a cinnamon stick, stirring until the sugar dissolves
Bring to a boil, take off the heat and steep 5 minutes
Strain into mugs and serve hot

name: Café Bombón
steps: Add condensed milk to a small glass
Pour espresso slowly on top to keep two layers

name: Café con Leche
steps: Pour strong coffee
Add an equal-ish pour of hot milk

name: Flat White
steps: Pull a double shot
Pour silky micro-foamed milk

name: Apple Crisp Macchiato
steps: Warm milk with apple syrup and cinnamon
Pour espresso on top
Drizzle with spiced caramel

name: Gingerbread Latte
steps: Stir gingerbread syrup (molasses, ginger, spice) into espresso
Top with steamed milk

name: Peppermint Mocha
steps: Stir chocolate and peppermint into espresso
Top with steamed milk

name: Pistachio Latte (Hot)
steps: Blend pistachio paste into hot milk
Pour over espresso

name: Billionaire's Latte
steps: Stir caramel and chocolate into espresso
Top with steamed milk and shortbread crumbs

name: Eggnog Latte
steps: Gently heat milk, cream, yolk and sugar until thick (no boil)
Pour over espresso, grate nutmeg on top

name: Ruby Chocolate Latte
steps: Melt ruby chocolate into hot milk
Add a short espresso

name: Coconut Milk Coffee (Hot)
steps: Heat and froth coconut milk
Pour over coffee

name: South Indian Filter Coffee
steps: Brew a strong decoction with ground filter coffee
Put sugar in the tumbler, add hot milk, then the decoction
Pour back and forth between tumbler and dabara 2 to 3 times to froth

name: Thai Spiced Iced Tea
steps: Pour sweetened Thai tea over crushed ice
Float evaporated milk on top

name: Earl Grey Fog & Tonic
steps: Stir tea, lemon and honey with ice
Top with tonic

name: Peach Rosemary Iced Tea
steps: Stir tea, peach and rosemary syrup hard with ice

name: Matcha Vanilla Swirl
steps: Whisk matcha with warm water until frothy
Fill glass with ice, milk and vanilla
Pour matcha slowly on top to swirl

name: Matcha Island
steps: Shake matcha with pineapple, coconut, lime and syrup
Strain over ice

name: Masala Chai
steps: Bring water to a gentle boil with the crushed whole spices and ginger
Add the tea leaves and simmer 1 to 2 minutes
Add milk and sugar, bring to a boil and simmer a minute, then strain into cups

name: Adrak Chai (Ginger Tea)
steps: Boil grated ginger in water
Add tea, milk and sugar; simmer and strain

name: Elaichi Chai (Cardamom Tea)
steps: Crush cardamom and boil with water
Add tea, milk and sugar; simmer and strain

name: Doodh Patti Chai
steps: Simmer tea leaves directly in milk (little or no water)
Sweeten and strain

name: Karak Chai
steps: Strongly boil tea with cardamom and saffron
Add evaporated milk and sugar; reduce until rich

name: Kesar Chai (Saffron Tea)
steps: Bloom saffron in warm milk
Brew tea with cardamom, add saffron milk, simmer

name: Lemon Ginger Tea
steps: Simmer sliced ginger in water
Off heat, add lemon and honey

name: Iced Chai Latte
steps: Pour chai concentrate over ice
Top with cold milk

name: Chai Blossom Soda
steps: Stir spiced chai syrup with lime over ice
Top with club soda

name: Classic Southern Sweet Tea
steps: Steep strong black tea and stir the sugar in while it is hot
Dilute with cool water and chill
Serve over ice

name: Chamomile Honey Iced Tea
steps: Brew chamomile, sweeten with honey, cool
Pour over ice with lemon

name: Masala Shikanji
steps: Dissolve lemon, syrup, roasted cumin and black salt
Add ice and soda; stir in mint

name: Nimbu Pani
steps: Squeeze the lemon into cold water
Add sugar, black salt, roasted cumin and chaat masala
Stir until the sugar dissolves, then taste and adjust

name: Jaljeera
steps: Blend herbs, tamarind, spices and lemon with a little water
Strain into an iced glass and top up with water or soda

name: Jeera Pani Soda
steps: Stir roasted cumin, lemon, salt and a little sugar
Top with soda over ice

name: Masala Soda
steps: Add masala, lemon and sugar to the glass
Top with very fizzy soda and stir quickly

name: Aam Panna
steps: Cook the raw mango in a little water until soft
Blend with sugar or jaggery and mint, then strain
Stir in cumin, black salt and pepper
Dilute the concentrate with cold water and serve chilled

name: Kokum Sharbat
steps: Put the kokum concentrate (kokum cooked with sugar, cumin, cardamom and black salt) in a glass
Top with chilled water or soda
Add a few ice cubes and garnish with mint

name: Sol Kadhi
steps: Whisk kokum extract into coconut milk
Season with ginger, chili, salt and coriander

name: Rooh Afza Sharbat
steps: Soak the sabja seeds in water for 30 minutes and drain
Stir the Rooh Afza syrup into cold water
Add the soaked seeds and ice, and stir well

name: Mango Cardamom Lassi
steps: Blend mango, yogurt, milk, honey and cardamom until frothy
Pour over two ice cubes

name: Sweet Lassi
steps: Blend chilled yogurt, sugar, cardamom and rose water
Add chilled water and blend until smooth and frothy

name: Rose Cardamom Lassi
steps: Blend yogurt with rose syrup and cardamom

name: Salted Mint Lassi
steps: Blend yogurt with mint, cumin and salt

name: Cardamom Banana Lassi
steps: Blend all until smooth

name: Melon Lassi
steps: Blend frozen melon with yogurt and sugar

name: Strawberry Lassi
steps: Blend strawberries, yogurt, sugar and milk

name: Mango Coconut Passionfruit Lassi (Dairy-Free)
steps: Blend mango, coconut yogurt/milk and passionfruit until smooth

name: Kefir Mango Lassi
steps: Blend mango with kefir (or thin yogurt) and honey

name: Masala Chaas
steps: Whisk yogurt thin with water
Season with cumin, salt, ginger and herbs

name: Soda Chaas
steps: Whisk spiced buttermilk
Top with soda just before serving

name: Piyush
steps: Whisk thick sweet yogurt (shrikhand) with milk
Flavour with saffron, cardamom and nutmeg

name: Thandai
steps: Grind soaked nuts, seeds and spices into a paste
Blend with cold milk, sugar and saffron
Strain and chill

name: Mango Thandai
steps: Blend thandai masala with mango pulp and cold milk

name: Mango Mastani
steps: Blend mango and milk into a thick shake
Top with a scoop of ice cream and nuts

name: Rose Falooda
steps: Layer rose syrup, soaked sabja and falooda sev
Pour cold milk
Top with ice cream

name: Badam Milk
steps: Blend soaked almonds into milk
Simmer with saffron, cardamom and sugar
Serve warm or chilled

name: Kesar Milk (Saffron Milk)
steps: Simmer milk with saffron and cardamom
Sweeten and add slivered nuts

name: Masala Doodh
steps: Simmer milk with masala doodh powder (nuts, spices)
Sweeten and serve hot

name: Saffron Cardamom Horchata
steps: Soak rice and almonds; blend with water and strain
Sweeten, add saffron and cardamom, serve over ice

name: Watermelon Juice (Tarbooz)
steps: Blend watermelon and strain
Add lemon, a pinch of salt and mint

name: Fresh Pomegranate Juice
steps: Pulse arils briefly and strain
Add a dash of lemon and salt

name: Fresh Pineapple Juice
steps: Blend pineapple with a little water
Strain and serve cold

name: Mint & Clove Ginger Beer (Homemade)
steps: Simmer ginger and cloves in syrup; cool
Muddle mint with lime
Add syrup and ice, top with soda

name: Fiery Ginger Beer Bug
steps: Stir fresh ginger juice, lime and honey syrup
Add ice and top with sparkling water

name: Spiced Apple Cider Sparkler
steps: Whisk cider, lemon and spices in the glass
Add ice, top with ginger ale

name: Tamarind Chili Salt Cooler
steps: Rim with lime and chili salt
Stir tamarind, lime and agave
Add ice and top with sparkling water

name: Golden Turmeric Elixir
steps: Shake turmeric, ginger, lemon, honey, pepper and coconut water with ice
Double strain over fresh ice

name: Pineapple Jalapeño Smash
steps: Gently muddle jalapeño with lime and agave
Shake with pineapple and ice
Strain and float soda

name: Smoked Orange & Cardamom Fizz
steps: Char orange halves and juice them
Shake with cardamom syrup and lemon
Strain and top with tonic

name: Cranberry Rosemary Shrub
steps: Pour cranberry shrub and orange juice into the glass
Fill with ice and top with soda
Stir with rosemary

name: Blood Orange Ginger Elixir
steps: Shake blood orange, ginger syrup and lime with ice
Strain over a large cube; top with soda

name: Kadha (Immunity Brew)
steps: Simmer water with tulsi, ginger, pepper, cloves and cinnamon until reduced
Sweeten with jaggery and strain

name: Golden Milk (Haldi Doodh)
steps: Simmer milk with turmeric, ginger and pepper
Strain, cool slightly, stir in honey

name: Homemade Electrolyte Drink
steps: Stir lemon, honey and a pinch of salt into water and coconut water
Chill

name: Easy Mulled Apple Cider
steps: Simmer cider with cinnamon, cloves, orange and ginger for 15 minutes
Ladle into mugs

name: Apple Cider Vinegar Morning Tonic
steps: Stir everything into cool water

name: On The Mend Hot Toddy (Zero-Proof)
steps: Steep tea with cinnamon and clove
Stir in honey and lemon

name: Caramelized Apple Crisp Mocktail
steps: Shake cider, cinnamon caramel, lemon and oat milk with ice
Double strain into a chilled coupe
Dust with nutmeg

name: Virgin Black Forest Cherry Fizz
steps: Mix chocolate and cherry at the base
Add ice and soda
Crown with whipped cream and a cherry

name: Orange Blossom Honey Spritz
steps: Stir orange blossom water, orange-honey and lemon in a flute
Top slowly with sparkling grape

name: Cranberry Cinnamon Spice Toddy (Chilled)
steps: Stir cranberry, cinnamon syrup and orange with ice
Top with ginger ale

name: Billionaire's Hot Chocolate
steps: Whisk chocolate and caramel into hot milk
Top with cream and crushed shortbread

name: Classic Hot Chocolate
steps: Stir sugar, cocoa and a splash of milk over medium heat until it boils, then cook 2 minutes
Take off the heat, add the rest of the milk and warm through without boiling
Serve hot with marshmallows

name: Eggless Eggnog
steps: Whisk milk, cream, condensed milk, spices and vanilla
Chill and grate nutmeg on top

name: Butterbeer (Fan Style)
steps: Stir butterscotch into cream soda
Float whipped butterscotch cream on top

name: Rum-Free Horchata Latte
steps: Blend soaked rice with cinnamon and water; strain
Sweeten, add milk and espresso over ice

name: Coconut Blackberry Smash
steps: Muddle blackberries
Add coconut, lime, syrup and ice; stir
Top with soda

name: Cookies & Cream Shake
steps: Blend ice cream, milk and crushed cookies until thick

name: Kala Khatta Sharbat
steps: Fill tall glass completely with crushed ice.
Pour kala khatta syrup, lemon juice, and spices over ice.
Top with club soda and stir thoroughly.

name: Banta / Street Goli Soda
steps: Mix lemon, spices, and sugar syrup in a tall glass.
Add ice cubes to halfway point.
Pour chilled club soda rapidly to build high effervescence.

name: Fuljar Soda (Kerala Spiced Drop Shot)
steps: Mix green paste, lemon, syrup, and sabja in a small shot glass.
Fill a large highball glass with chilled club soda.
Drop shot glass into soda and consume immediately as it fizzes.

name: Kacha Aam Pudina Fizz
steps: Muddle mint with green mango puree, syrup, and black salt.
Add ice cubes to brim.
Top with sparkling soda water and lift mint with stirrer.

name: Imli Ka Amlana (Rajasthani Tamarind Cooler)
steps: Whisk tamarind pulp, sugar, and spices into chilled water.
Strain liquid into ice-filled glass.
Garnish with fresh mint leaves.

name: Street-Style Masala Cola
steps: Add spices and lemon juice into ice-filled glass.
Slowly pour cold cola down the glass wall.
Stir gently once to blend without losing effervescence.

name: Jeera Masala Soda
steps: Combine roasted cumin, tamarind syrup, lemon, and salt.
Fill glass with cubed ice.
Top with club soda and stir gently.

name: Pudina Nimbu Sharbat
steps: Blend mint, sugar, lemon juice with 50 ml water.
Strain green liquid into glass packed with ice.
Add black salt, top with remaining cold water, stir well.

name: Classic Rose / Rooh Afza Sharbat
steps: Add rose syrup, lemon juice, and hydrated sabja seeds to glass.
Fill with ice cubes and chilled water.
Stir well to distribute gelatinous seeds evenly.

name: Khus Sharbat (Vetiver Grass Cooler)
steps: Pour green khus syrup and lime juice over ice.
Add hydrated sabja seeds.
Top with cold water or soda and stir until brilliant green.

name: Nannari Sharbat (Sarsaparilla Root Cooler)
steps: Spoon nannari syrup, lemon juice, and sabja seeds into glass.
Fill glass completely with ice.
Top with cold water or sparkling soda and stir.

name: Panakam (South Indian Jaggery Tonic)
steps: Dissolve jaggery completely in 250 ml water; strain impurities.
Stir in dry ginger, cardamom, black pepper, and lemon juice.
Chill well and top with bruised fresh tulsi (holy basil) leaves.

name: Bel Ka Sharbat (Wood Apple Tonic)
steps: Soak bel pulp in water for 15 min; gently strain pulp manually.
Mix nectar with jaggery, cumin, and black salt.
Serve cold over fresh ice cubes.

name: Namkeen Sattu Sharbat (Savory Gram Cooler)
steps: Whisk sattu flour with 50 ml water into smooth paste.
Add remaining 200 ml chilled water, lemon juice, and spices.
Stir in finely chopped onion, chili, and mint before serving.

name: Meetha Sattu Sharbat (Sweet Roasted Gram)
steps: Dissolve powdered jaggery completely in chilled water.
Whisk in sattu flour and cardamom until smooth.
Pour into glass over ice cubes.

name: Gond Katira Rose Cooler
steps: Spoon hydrated jelly-like gond katira into glass base.
Add rose syrup, lemon juice, and ice.
Top with cold water and stir gently.

name: Variyali Sharbat (Gujarati Fennel Cooler)
steps: Soak fennel and cardamom for 3 hours; blend with mishri.
Strain tightly through fine cloth/sieve.
Mix green extract into chilled water with lemon juice over ice.

name: Buransh Juice (Himalayan Rhododendron)
steps: Pour red buransh squash and lemon juice into glass.
Fill glass with ice cubes.
Top with chilled water and stir gently; garnish with mint.

name: Punjabi Sweet Malai Lassi
steps: Churn curd, sugar, cardamom, and milk using wooden churner until frothy.
Pour thick lassi into tall glass.
Dollop fresh malai on top and sprinkle crushed pistachios.

name: Alphonso Mango Lassi
steps: Combine mango pulp, yogurt, milk, honey, and cardamom in blender.
Blend for 20 seconds until silky and thick.
Pour into glass over 2 ice cubes and dust with cardamom.

name: Gulkand Rose Lassi
steps: Blend yogurt, gulkand, rose syrup, and milk until frothy.
Pour into chilled glass.
Garnish with dried edible rose petals and slivered almonds.
garnish: dried edible rose petals and slivered al

name: Namkeen Pudina Lassi
steps: Blend yogurt, water, mint, roasted cumin, and black salt.
Pour over fresh ice cubes in a rocks or highball glass.
Dust top with extra roasted cumin powder.

name: Tadka Chaas (Tempered Buttermilk)
steps: Whisk curd, water, and salt into smooth buttermilk.
Heat ghee in tiny pan; splutter mustard, cumin, curry leaves, hing.
Pour sizzling tempering over cold buttermilk; stir gently.

name: Sambharam / Neer Mor (South Indian Buttermilk)
steps: Churn curd and water until light and frothy.
Crush curry leaves, ginger, and green chili in mortar; stir in.
Add salt and hing; steep for 15 minutes before serving cold.

name: Awadhi Mattha
steps: Whisk curd and water until completely smooth.
Mix in roasted cumin, mint powder, black salt, and chili powder.
Pour into glass and float salted boondi on top.

name: Strawberry Cardamom Lassi
steps: Blend strawberries, yogurt, milk, honey, and cardamom.
Blend until vibrant pink and frothy.
Serve chilled over fresh ice cubes.

name: Banarasi Thandai
steps: Whisk thandai paste and sugar into chilled milk until smooth.
Rest for 1 hour in refrigerator to infuse flavors.
Strain if preferred, pour over ice, garnish with saffron & nuts.

name: Kesar Badam Milk
steps: Blend soaked almonds with 30 ml milk into paste.
Simmer remaining milk with saffron, sugar, cardamom, and paste for 8 min.
Serve piping hot or thoroughly chilled.

name: Madurai Jigarthanda
steps: Layer soaked badam pisin jelly at glass base.
Add nannari syrup, then pour chilled reduced milk over.
Top with a scoop of malai ice cream.

name: Mohabbat Ka Sharbat (Old Delhi Watermelon Milk)
steps: Stir Rooh Afza into cold milk until deep pink.
Add ice cubes to glass.
Fold in finely diced watermelon cubes; serve with spoon/straw.

name: Kesar Pista Falooda
steps: Add sabja seeds and cooked vermicelli to glass base.
Pour chilled saffron milk.
Crown with kesar-pista ice cream and crushed pistachios.

name: Banarasi Paan Shot
steps: Blend betel leaves, gulkand, fennel, coconut, milk, and ice cream.
Blend on high until vibrant green and smooth.
Strain into shot glasses; serve chilled.

name: Chikoo (Sapota) Milkshake
steps: Add chikoo flesh, cold milk, sweetener, cinnamon, and ice to blender.
Blend until thick and frothy.
Pour into tall glass and serve cold.

name: Sitaphal (Custard Apple) Rabri Shake
steps: Pulse custard apple pulp briefly with chilled milk, sugar, and cardamom.
Keep blending minimal to retain pulp texture.
Serve chilled in short rocks glasses.

name: Anjeer Badam Shake (Fig & Almond)
steps: Blend soaked figs and almonds with a splash of milk into smooth paste.
Add remaining chilled milk, honey, and cardamom.
Blend until frothy; serve chilled.

name: Ganne Ka Ras (Spiced Sugarcane Juice)
steps: Combine sugarcane juice, ginger juice, lemon juice, and black salt.
Vigorously shake with crushed ice in cocktail shaker.
Strain into glass filled with mint and fresh ice.

name: Elaneer Shake (Tender Coconut Milkshake)
steps: Add coconut malai, coconut water, milk, condensed milk, and cardamom.
Blend for 30 seconds until velvety smooth.
Serve chilled in tall glass.

name: Falsa Sharbat (Sherbet Berry Juice)
steps: Mash berries with water to release pulp; strain seeds out.
Stir sugar, black salt, and roasted cumin into ruby juice.
Serve over ice cubes.

name: Jamun Shots (Black Plum Cooler)
steps: Rim shot glasses with lemon and red chili-salt mixture.
Blend jamun pulp, lemon juice, black salt, sugar, water, and ice.
Pour thick purple slush into rimmed shot glasses.

name: Mosambi (Sweet Lime) Masala Juice
steps: Stir black salt, chaat masala, and lemon juice into sweet lime juice.
Add ice cubes immediately.
Serve fresh to prevent oxidation bitterness.

name: Watermelon Rooh Afza Mint Cooler
steps: Muddle mint leaves lightly inside highball glass.
Add ice, watermelon juice, Rooh Afza, lime juice, and black salt.
Stir gently to integrate layers.

sub: Iconic Hot & Iced Teas, Coffees & Warm Tonics
name: Cutting Masala Chai
steps: Boil water with crushed ginger, cardamom, and cinnamon for 2 min.
Add tea leaves and sugar; simmer 1 min. Pour milk and boil 3 min.
Strain hot into small glasses.

sub: Iconic Hot & Iced Teas, Coffees & Warm Tonics
name: Kashmiri Kahwa
steps: Simmer water with cinnamon, cardamom, and cloves for 4 min.
Off heat, steep green tea and saffron for 2 min; strain.
Stir in honey and float slivered almonds.

sub: Iconic Hot & Iced Teas, Coffees & Warm Tonics
name: Kashmiri Noon Chai (Pink Salt Tea)
steps: Boil tea and baking soda in water; shock with cold water and aerate.
Add milk and salt until pastel pink; simmer 2 min.
Strain into cup and sprinkle pistachios.

sub: Iconic Hot & Iced Teas, Coffees & Warm Tonics
name: South Indian Filter Kaapi
steps: Add sugar and dark decoction to tumbler.
Pour boiling frothy milk.
Pour back and forth between tumbler and dabarah from height to froth.

sub: Iconic Hot & Iced Teas, Coffees & Warm Tonics
name: Haldi Doodh (Golden Turmeric Milk)
steps: Simmer milk with turmeric, ginger, cinnamon, and pepper for 5 min.
Turn off heat and let cool slightly.
Stir in honey, strain into mug, serve warm.

name: Jamun Mint Mojito
steps: Muddle mint leaves with lime juice and sugar syrup in a glass.
Add jamun pulp and fill glass with ice cubes.
Top with sparkling soda water and stir gently.

name: Guava Chili Spritzer
steps: Rim glass with mixed red chili powder and salt.
Fill glass with ice and pour pink guava juice and lemon.
Top with chilled club soda and stir carefully.

name: Lahori Zeera Soda
steps: Combine roasted cumin, black salt, amchur, and lemon juice.
Add cubed ice to a highball glass.
Top with chilled soda water and stir immediately.

name: Anardana Lemonade
steps: Crush anardana seeds and steep in warm water for 15 minutes.
Strain liquid into ice-filled glass.
Add lemon juice, sugar, black salt, and top with chilled water.

name: Kamrakh (Starfruit) Mint Sharbat
steps: Blend sliced starfruit, mint, sugar, black salt, and water.
Strain pulp through a fine sieve into an ice-filled glass.
Garnish with a starfruit wheel.

name: Hing & Pudina Lemon Fizz
steps: Muddle mint with lemon juice, hing, cumin, and salt.
Add ice cubes to highball glass.
Pour cold soda over ice and stir once.

name: Phalsa Mint Sparkler
steps: Add falsa concentrate and lime juice to a glass over ice.
Slap mint leaves and drop inside.
Top with sparkling water and stir.

name: Spicy Tamarind Ginger Cooler
steps: Simmer tamarind and fresh ginger with jaggery to make syrup.
Pour 30 ml syrup into glass with ice and black salt.
Top with cold water or soda and stir well.

name: Karonda (Natal Plum) Sharbat
steps: Boil karondas with sugar and water until soft; crush and strain.
Chill the vibrant pink-red liquid.
Serve over ice with black salt and cumin.

name: Kokum Ginger Sparkling Mule
steps: Mix kokum agal, ginger syrup, and honey in a glass base.
Fill with ice cubes.
Top with chilled soda water and stir gently.

name: Raw Mango Cardamom Punch
steps: Blend mango pulp with sugar syrup and green cardamom.
Pour into glass filled with crushed ice.
Top with cold water and stir till chilled.

name: Masala Orange Spritz
steps: Stir chaat masala and black salt into fresh orange juice.
Add ice to glass.
Top with club soda and stir softly.

name: Sweet & Spicy Pineapple Panna
steps: Blend grilled pineapple with jaggery, cumin, and black salt.
Strain juice into glass filled with ice.
Top with cold water and stir.

name: Nimbu Black Pepper Tonic
steps: Mix lime juice, honey water, and black pepper in glass base.
Add ice cubes to top.
Pour cold water and stir thoroughly.

name: Spicy Anardana Mint Cooler Crushed
steps: Muddle anardana and mint together in mortar.
Transfer to glass with lemon juice and black salt.
Add ice and top with chilled club soda.

name: Cucumber Mint Masala Fizz
steps: Muddle cucumber slices and mint in glass.
Add lemon juice, chaat masala, and ice cubes.
Top with club soda and stir gently.

name: Wood Apple Mint Fizz
steps: Stir bel pulp with simple syrup, cumin, and crushed mint.
Fill glass with ice cubes.
Top with cold club soda and mix gently.

name: Chandan (Sandalwood) Sharbat
steps: Pour sandalwood syrup and lime juice over ice in a glass.
Add hydrated sabja seeds.
Fill with cold water and stir until aromatic.

name: Mogra (Jasmine) Nectar Sharbat
steps: Combine jasmine syrup and fresh lemon juice in glass.
Add ice cubes and cold spring water.
Garnish with fresh washed jasmine petals.

name: Brahmi Cooling Tonic
steps: Whisk brahmi syrup, honey, and cardamom into chilled water.
Pour over ice in a highball glass.
Serve cold as a restorative brain tonic.

name: Shankhpushpi Herbal Elixir
steps: Stir shankhpushpi extract, lemon juice, and rock sugar syrup.
Add ice to glass.
Fill with cold water and stir thoroughly.

name: Parijat (Night Jasmine) Infusion
steps: Steep parijat petals in warm water, strain and chill.
Mix chilled tea with honey and lime juice.
Serve over ice cubes.

name: Curry Leaf & Lemon Tonic
steps: Muddle curry leaves gently with lemon juice and simple syrup.
Strain into glass packed with ice.
Top with cold water and pinch of black salt.

name: Tulsi Ginger Honey Tonic
steps: Muddle tulsi leaves with ginger juice and honey.
Pour cold or warm water and stir until honey dissolves.
Strain and serve with a tulsi leaf float.

name: Hibiscus (Gudhal) Ruby Sharbat
steps: Brew dried hibiscus flowers, strain and cool.
Mix hibiscus extract with lime juice and rock sugar syrup.
Pour over ice and top with chilled water.

name: Vetiver Rose Herbal Cooler
steps: Layer khus syrup and rose syrup in glass with ice.
Add lemon juice and chilled water.
Stir to create a dual-tone botanical beverage.

name: Saunf Mishri Wellness Water
steps: Soak fennel and mishri in water overnight.
Strain through fine cloth into glass.
Add cardamom powder and ice before drinking.

name: Lemongrass Ginger Iced Tonic
steps: Boil bruised lemongrass, strain and chill completely.
Mix lemongrass tea with ginger juice and honey.
Pour over ice and garnish with a lime slice.

name: Badian (Star Anise) Herbal Fizz
steps: Add star anise syrup and fresh lemon juice to glass.
Fill with ice cubes.
Top with club soda; garnish with floating star anise pod.

name: Bael Leaves Digestive Tea
steps: Boil bael leaves in water for 5 minutes; strain.
Stir in jaggery and cumin powder.
Serve warm or chilled over ice.

name: Arjun Bark Cardiac Tonic
steps: Simmer arjun bark powder in water until reduced by half.
Add milk and jaggery; boil for 2 minutes.
Strain and serve warm with cardamom.

name: Mulethi (Licorice) Root Tonic
steps: Crush mulethi stick and simmer in water for 7 minutes.
Add black pepper; strain into cup.
Stir in honey and serve warm or iced.

name: Neem Honey Detox
steps: Muddle tender neem leaves into fine paste with lemon juice.
Whisk with honey and water until blended.
Strain through fine mesh before drinking.

name: Kanji (Fermented Black Carrot Drink)
steps: Combine carrots, ground mustard, and salts in ceramic jar with water.
Keep in sunlight for 3 days to ferment until pungent and purple.
Strain and serve chilled as a digestive probiotic.
Recipe scaled down to a single glass from a batch.

name: Beetroot Masala Chaas
steps: Whisk curd, beetroot puree, and water till combined.
Stir in roasted cumin and black salt.
Serve chilled garnished with chopped mint.

name: Cucumber Mint Chaas
steps: Blend curd, cucumber, mint leaves, water, and seasonings.
Strain through coarse sieve to remove fibers.
Serve over ice with a pinch of cumin on top.

name: Dhungar (Smoked) Masala Chaas Coal
steps: Place small metal cup inside buttermilk pot.
Put red-hot charcoal inside, drop ghee, cumin, and hing on it.
Cover pot immediately for 2 minutes to infuse smoke, then stir.

name: Roasted Garlic Chaas
steps: Mash roasted garlic cloves into a smooth paste.
Whisk garlic paste into curd, cold water, cumin, and salt.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve cold.

name: Peach Elaichi Lassi Blended
steps: Blend ripe peach slices, curd, milk, sugar, and cardamom.
Process until silky and frothy.
Serve chilled over ice cubes.

name: Pineapple Mint Lassi Blended
steps: Blend pineapple, mint, yogurt, honey, and black salt.
Blend on high until completely smooth.
Pour into tall glass over ice.

name: Guava Red Chili Lassi Blended
steps: Blend guava pulp, yogurt, sugar, and cumin until smooth.
Pour into glass.
Dust tiny pinch of red chili powder on top before serving.

name: Kesar Badam Lassi Rich
steps: Soak saffron in warm milk for 10 minutes.
Churn curd, almond paste, sugar, saffron milk, and cardamom.
Garnish with chopped almonds and saffron.

name: Blueberry Cardamom Lassi Blended
steps: Blend blueberries, yogurt, honey, and cardamom powder.
Blend until deep purple and creamy.
Serve thoroughly chilled.

name: Avocado Honey Lassi
steps: Blend avocado flesh with yogurt, milk, honey, and cardamom.
Blend until thick, pale green, and ultra-smooth.
Serve cold in short tumbler glasses.

name: Banana Elaichi Lassi
steps: Combine sliced banana, yogurt, milk, sugar, and cardamom.
Blend until completely smooth and frothy.
Serve chilled over ice.

name: Rose Sabja Lassi Seed
steps: Churn yogurt, rose syrup, sugar, and milk until smooth.
Stir in soaked sabja seeds.
Pour into tall glass and garnish with edible rose petals.

name: Muskmelon (Kharbuja) Lassi Blended
steps: Blend melon cubes, curd, sugar, and cardamom powder.
Blend till frothy and orange-tinted.
Serve over ice cubes.

name: Apple Cinnamon Lassi Blended
steps: Blend apple cubes with yogurt, milk, honey, and cinnamon.
Blend thoroughly until fine and smooth.
Dust top with extra cinnamon powder.

name: Saffron Honey Lassi
steps: Whisk steeped saffron water, honey, yogurt, and cardamom.
Churn until light and airy.
Garnish with slivered pistachios.

name: Tender Coconut Lassi Blended Curd
steps: Blend coconut flesh with coconut water, yogurt, and sugar.
Process into thick white lassi.
Serve cold with cardamom sprinkle.

name: Spiced Hing Mattha
steps: Whisk curd, water, toasted hing, cumin, and black salt.
Pour into clay kulhad or glass.
Garnish with fresh coriander.

sub: Rich Milkshakes, Mastanis & Festive Dessert Shakes
name: Pune Mango Mastani Layered Shake &
steps: Pour thick mango shake into tall glass filling 3/4 depth.
Top with a large scoop of mango ice cream.
Garnish with cashews, almonds, cherry, and tutti-frutti.

sub: Rich Milkshakes, Mastanis & Festive Dessert Shakes
name: Dry Fruit Mastani Nut Shake
steps: Pour blended nut shake into glass.
Add ice cream scoop on top.
Decorate generously with sliced figs, dates, and almonds.

sub: Rich Milkshakes, Mastanis & Festive Dessert Shakes
name: Strawberry Mastani Layered
steps: Pour fresh strawberry shake into glass.
Crown with strawberry ice cream scoop.
Garnish with chopped strawberries and slivered nuts.

sub: Rich Milkshakes, Mastanis & Festive Dessert Shakes
name: Thandai Rose Milkshake Blended
steps: Blend cold milk, thandai paste, and rose syrup together.
Pour into tall glass over ice.
Top with slivered pistachios and rose petals.

sub: Rich Milkshakes, Mastanis & Festive Dessert Shakes
name: Rabri Falooda Glass Layered
steps: Layer sabja, rose syrup, and falooda sev in glass.
Add cold milk, then pour thick rabri over top.
Garnish with pistachios and almonds; serve with spoon.

sub: Rich Milkshakes, Mastanis & Festive Dessert Shakes
name: Pistachio Kesar Doodh Simmered
steps: Simmer milk with pistachio paste, saffron, sugar, cardamom for 7 min.
Serve hot or chill in refrigerator.
Garnish with crushed green pistachios.

sub: Rich Milkshakes, Mastanis & Festive Dessert Shakes
name: Badam Halwa Milkshake Blended
steps: Blend almond halwa into chilled milk with cardamom.
Blend until thick and completely combined.
Garnish with saffron and serve chilled.

sub: Rich Milkshakes, Mastanis & Festive Dessert Shakes
name: Khajoor (Date) Nut Milkshake Blended
steps: Soak dates and walnuts in warm milk for 20 minutes.
Blend into smooth paste, add rest of milk and nutmeg.
Blend until frothy and serve chilled.

sub: Rich Milkshakes, Mastanis & Festive Dessert Shakes
name: Chikoo Chocolate Shake Blended
steps: Blend chikoo flesh, cocoa powder, milk, and sugar.
Blend on high until velvety smooth.
Top with chocolate curls.

sub: Rich Milkshakes, Mastanis & Festive Dessert Shakes
name: Dry Fruit Cream Blend Ultra
steps: Blend nuts with milk into a smooth nut butter.
Add fresh cream, honey, and cardamom powder; pulse briefly.
Serve chilled in dessert glasses.

sub: Rich Milkshakes, Mastanis & Festive Dessert Shakes
name: Tender Coconut Malai Rose Shake Blended
steps: Blend coconut malai, milk, rose syrup, and sugar until thick.
Pour into tall glass over ice cubes.
Garnish with dried rose petals.

sub: Rich Milkshakes, Mastanis & Festive Dessert Shakes
name: Paan Falooda Special Layered
steps: Layer sabja seeds and cooked sev in tall glass.
Pour green paan milk over layers.
Crown with vanilla ice cream and spoonful of gulkand.

sub: Rich Milkshakes, Mastanis & Festive Dessert Shakes
name: Chocolate Paan Shake Blended
steps: Blend betel leaf, gulkand, chocolate syrup, milk, ice cream.
Blend until creamy and smooth.
Pour into chocolate-rimmed glass.

sub: Rich Milkshakes, Mastanis & Festive Dessert Shakes
name: Makhana (Foxnut) Milkshake Roasted
steps: Grind roasted makhana into fine powder.
Blend with cold milk, sugar, and cardamom powder.
Serve chilled garnished with almond flakes.

sub: Rich Milkshakes, Mastanis & Festive Dessert Shakes
name: Basundi Drink with Cardamom Poured
steps: Whisk basundi with cold milk to sipping consistency.
Stir in nutmeg and cardamom.
Serve chilled garnished with chipped pistachios.

sub: Rich Milkshakes, Mastanis & Festive Dessert Shakes
name: Cold Filter Coffee Milkshake Blended
steps: Blend coffee decoction, cold milk, sugar, ice cream.
Blend high speed till thick and frothy.
Dust cocoa powder on foam.

sub: Rich Milkshakes, Mastanis & Festive Dessert Shakes
name: Rose Thandai Shake Blended Nut &
steps: Blend milk, thandai powder, rose syrup, and ice cream.
Pour into tall chilled glass.
Garnish with dried rose petals.

sub: Coastal Coolers, Wild Berry & Tropical Fruit Nectars
name: Neera (Fresh Palm Nectar) Chilled
steps: Keep unfermented palm sap ice-chilled.
Add fresh lime juice to balance sweetness.
Serve immediately over ice.

sub: Coastal Coolers, Wild Berry & Tropical Fruit Nectars
name: Pathimugam (Kerala Herbal Pink Water) Boiled
steps: Boil sappanwood shavings in water for 5 minutes until pink.
Strain hot liquid.
Serve warm or chilled as everyday drinking water.
Recipe scaled down to a single glass from a batch.

sub: Coastal Coolers, Wild Berry & Tropical Fruit Nectars
name: Karikku (Tender Coconut) Cooler
steps: Mix cold coconut water with honey in glass.
Add delicate chopped tender coconut pieces.
Garnish with mint leaf float.

sub: Coastal Coolers, Wild Berry & Tropical Fruit Nectars
name: Jackfruit (Kathal) Nectar Blended
steps: Blend jackfruit bulbs with honey, cardamom, and cold water.
Strain pulp through coarse sieve.
Pour over ice and serve cold.

sub: Coastal Coolers, Wild Berry & Tropical Fruit Nectars
name: Guava Chaat Cooler Pressed
steps: Stir guava juice, lemon juice, chaat masala, black salt.
Fill glass with ice cubes.
Top with chilled soda water and stir gently.

sub: Coastal Coolers, Wild Berry & Tropical Fruit Nectars
name: Watermelon Black Salt Punch
steps: Stir black salt and roasted cumin into watermelon juice.
Pour over ice in tall glass.
Garnish with mint sprig and lime wheel.

sub: Coastal Coolers, Wild Berry & Tropical Fruit Nectars
name: Papaya Lime Mint Cooler Blended
steps: Blend papaya, lime juice, mint leaves, honey, and cold water.
Blend until completely smooth.
Serve chilled over ice.

sub: Coastal Coolers, Wild Berry & Tropical Fruit Nectars
name: Jamun Ginger Digestive Shot
steps: Shake jamun pulp, ginger juice, black salt, lemon juice with ice.
Strain into shot glass.
Serve as quick digestive shot.

sub: Coastal Coolers, Wild Berry & Tropical Fruit Nectars
name: Mulberry (Shahtoot) Sharbat
steps: Muddle mulberries with sugar and lemon juice; strain seeds.
Mix rich berry liquid into cold water.
Serve over ice cubes.

sub: Coastal Coolers, Wild Berry & Tropical Fruit Nectars
name: Custard Apple (Sitaphal) Rose Cooler Pulsed
steps: Pulse sitaphal pulp with rose syrup and cold water briefly.
Keep pulp texture intact.
Serve chilled over ice.

sub: Coastal Coolers, Wild Berry & Tropical Fruit Nectars
name: Lychee Rose Sparkler
steps: Mix lychee juice, rose syrup, and lime juice in glass with ice.
Top with chilled club soda.
Stir gently and serve.

sub: Coastal Coolers, Wild Berry & Tropical Fruit Nectars
name: Sweet Lime (Mosambi) Mint Cooler
steps: Muddle mint leaves in glass base.
Add ice cubes and black salt.
Pour fresh sweet lime juice and stir.

sub: Coastal Coolers, Wild Berry & Tropical Fruit Nectars
name: Raw Papaya Lemon Juice Pressed
steps: Stir raw papaya juice, lemon juice, honey, and black salt.
Add cold water and ice.
Serve crisp and cold.

sub: Coastal Coolers, Wild Berry & Tropical Fruit Nectars
name: Wild Fig (Anjeer) Nectar
steps: Boil figs in water with jaggery and cinnamon; blend and strain.
Chill fig nectar in refrigerator.
Serve over ice cubes.

sub: Coastal Coolers, Wild Berry & Tropical Fruit Nectars
name: Plum Mint Punch
steps: Blend stewed plum puree, lemon juice, sugar, and water.
Strain red juice over ice.
Garnish with slapped mint sprig.

sub: Coastal Coolers, Wild Berry & Tropical Fruit Nectars
name: Rasbhari (Cape Gooseberry) Sharbat
steps: Blend cape gooseberries with sugar, black salt, cold water.
Strain seeds out through fine mesh.
Serve yellow juice over ice.

sub: Coastal Coolers, Wild Berry & Tropical Fruit Nectars
name: Pomegranate Mint Elixir Pressed
steps: Stir muddled mint, cumin, and lime into pomegranate juice.
Fill glass with ice.
Pour nectar and serve cold.

sub: Spiced Teas, Heritage Coffees & Warm Restorative Brews
name: Sulaimani Tea (Kerala Spiced Black Tea) Boiled
steps: Boil water with spices for 3 minutes. Add tea leaves; steep 1 min.
Strain into cup; add sugar and lemon juice until golden amber.
Serve hot after meals.

sub: Spiced Teas, Heritage Coffees & Warm Restorative Brews
name: Chukku Kappi (Dry Ginger Coffee)
steps: Boil water with dry ginger, black pepper, cardamom, palm jaggery 6 min.
Add coffee powder; boil 1 minute.
Strain and serve hot as medicinal brew.

sub: Spiced Teas, Heritage Coffees & Warm Restorative Brews
name: Adrak Elaichi Chai Simmered
steps: Boil ginger and crushed cardamom in water for 3 minutes.
Add tea leaves and sugar; simmer 1 min. Add milk; boil 3 min.
Strain into tea cup.

sub: Spiced Teas, Heritage Coffees & Warm Restorative Brews
name: Gur Wali Chai (Jaggery Tea) Simmered
steps: Boil water, tea leaves, and fennel for 2 minutes.
Add milk and boil 2 minutes. Turn off heat.
Stir in jaggery off heat to prevent curdling; strain.

sub: Spiced Teas, Heritage Coffees & Warm Restorative Brews
name: Lemongrass Mint Chai Boiled
steps: Boil lemongrass and mint in water for 4 minutes.
Add tea leaves, sugar, and milk; boil for 3 minutes.
Strain hot into chai glass.

sub: Spiced Teas, Heritage Coffees & Warm Restorative Brews
name: Kashmiri Rose Kahwa Infused
steps: Simmer water, cinnamon, and rose petals for 3 minutes.
Off heat, steep green tea and saffron for 2 min.
Strain, add honey, float almonds.

sub: Spiced Teas, Heritage Coffees & Warm Restorative Brews
name: Chocolate Masala Chai Simmered
steps: Boil spices and tea leaves in water for 2 minutes.
Whisk in cocoa powder, sugar, and milk; boil 3 minutes.
Strain into mug.

sub: Spiced Teas, Heritage Coffees & Warm Restorative Brews
name: Indian Spiced Iced Tea Chilled
steps: Combine cold black tea, lemon juice, simple syrup, chaat masala.
Shake with ice cubes in shaker.
Strain over fresh ice; garnish with mint.

sub: Spiced Teas, Heritage Coffees & Warm Restorative Brews
name: Cinnamon Mulethi Warm Brew
steps: Simmer cinnamon and mulethi root in water for 8 minutes.
Strain into mug.
Stir in honey and add lemon slice.

sub: Spiced Teas, Heritage Coffees & Warm Restorative Brews
name: Turmeric Pepper Golden Brew
steps: Boil turmeric, black pepper, and ginger in water for 5 minutes.
Strain into tea glass.
Stir in raw honey and drink warm.

sub: Spiced Teas, Heritage Coffees & Warm Restorative Brews
name: Jaggery Lemon Black Tea Boiled
steps: Boil water, tea leaves, cardamom, and jaggery for 3 minutes.
Strain into tea cup.
Stir in lemon juice and serve hot.

sub: Spiced Teas, Heritage Coffees & Warm Restorative Brews
name: Kashmiri Pink Salt Ginger Tea Salted
steps: Boil ginger and tea leaves in water for 3 minutes.
Stir in warm milk and pink salt.
Strain and serve hot in clay cup.

sub: Spiced Teas, Heritage Coffees & Warm Restorative Brews
name: Green Cardamom Hot Milk Infusion
steps: Crush green cardamoms and simmer in milk for 6 minutes.
Add sugar and saffron; stir well.
Strain into mug and serve warm before bedtime.

sub: Spiced Teas, Heritage Coffees & Warm Restorative Brews
name: Pudina Chai (Fresh Mint Tea) Simmered
steps: Boil fresh mint leaves in water for 3 minutes.
Add tea leaves, sugar, and milk; simmer 3 minutes.
Strain into glass and serve piping hot.

sub: Spiced Teas, Heritage Coffees & Warm Restorative Brews
name: Saunf Elaichi Hot Milk Infused
steps: Crush fennel seeds and cardamoms; boil in milk for 5 minutes.
Stir in crushed mishri rock sugar until dissolved.
Strain hot into mug; serve warm.

name: Omija-cha (Five-Flavor Tea)
steps: Steep berries in cold water for 12 hours
Strain, sweeten with honey, and serve cold over ice with pine nuts
Recipe scaled down to a single glass from a batch.

name: Sikhye (Sweet Rice Punch)
steps: Steep malt powder in warm water, settle sediment
Combine clear liquor with cooked rice in rice cooker warm setting for 5 hours until grains float
Boil with sugar; chill
Recipe scaled down to a single glass from a batch.

name: Sujeonggwa (Cinnamon Dried Persimmon Punch)
steps: Simmer ginger and cinnamon separately in water for 30 min
